objections.claim: Section 6b contradicts the fixed Eye ruling in `2026-08-28-product-1-six-rulings-final.md` item 6. That ruling classifies interim source review plus the finite battery as compensating controls only and expressly forbids representing them as proof of semantic soundness; the candidate instead claims that correction (d) is enforced in the interim and that the lookup-table attack is closed at every stage. Until the constrained declarative grammar and trusted evaluator pass their hard merge gate, a lookup-table oracle remains expressible and source review is not the deterministic discriminator required by frozen governance correction (d). The approach must make pre-evaluator enrollment/authority fail closed for new or changed normative oracles, or describe the interim controls only as non-authoritative evidence without claiming correction (d) is closed.
